shrink: node scripts/validate-html.js --shrink drops a recorded occurrence when the page no longer has that finding. It refuses to add an occurrence or raise a count. The check fails when a scanned page has a finding this file does not list, and when a listed finding is gone: a fixed error does not free a slot.

rules.prefer-native-element: Two comparison tables use div.table-wrap with role=region, the scrollable-region pattern this repo requires. A native section would inherit section { padding: 60px 0; overflow: hidden; } and change the layout.

prefer-native-element:
#blog-post > div > div > div > article > div > div
Prefer to use the native <section> element
role="region"
